AFCAT 02/2026 Online Form Date Extended - Complete Details

AFCAT 02/2026 Online Form Date Extended. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website before the last date. The last date to apply is 21/06/2026. Check important dates, application fee, eligibility criteria and official links below.

Important Dates

  • Exam Name : AFCAT July 2027
  • Last Date : 21/06/2026
  • Apply Online Start Date : 20/05/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 21/06/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 21/06/2026
  • Admit Card Released Date : As Per Schedule
  • Exam Date : 08/08/2026
  • Result Declare Date : As Per Schedule
  • AFCAT Entry for All Candidate : Rs. 550/-

Application Fee

  • Pay Scale : Level – 7
  • Last Date : 21/06/2026
  • Apply Online Start Date : 20/05/2026
  • Apply Online Last Date : 21/06/2026
  • Last Date Pay Fees : 21/06/2026

How to Apply Online

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the online application / registration link.
  3. Register with your basic details like name, email, mobile number.
  4. Fill the application form with personal, educational and address details.
  5. Upload scanned photograph, signature and required documents.
  6. Pay the application fee online.
  7. Submit the form and take a printout for future reference.
